verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an official Web SDK that ships with TypeScript types. Its method reference covers creating a client, connect, quotes, payment methods, and buy, Apple Pay and Google Pay frames, and there is also an official `@moonpay/platform-sdk-react-native` package for mobile. OpenAPI-based typed client generation adds a further path, though that is codegen rather than an SDK itself. missing for 10: native iOS/Android/Flutter or server-side SDKs (docs say to drive frames directly on those platforms), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
